videoFrameIntervalSeconds.label: Video sampling interval
videoFrameIntervalSeconds.description: Extract one frame per interval. Smaller intervals increase processing time.

videoStartSeconds.label: Video start
videoStartSeconds.description: Start extracting each video at this time.

videoEndSeconds.label: Video end
videoEndSeconds.description: Stop extracting each video at this time; empty uses the whole video.

excludedPaths.label: Excluded files
excludedPaths.description: Capture-relative file paths to skip during preparation.

maxMeshVertices.label: Maximum mesh vertices
maxMeshVertices.description: Override the quality preset mesh limit for ODM; empty uses the preset.

textureResolution.label: Texture resolution
textureResolution.description: Texture atlas side length for Meshroom; empty uses the engine template.

quality.label: Reconstruction quality
quality.description: Higher quality increases processing time and memory use. Results vary by engine.

confidence.label: Minimum confidence
confidence.description: Lower values find more candidates, including more false detections.

tileOverlap.label: Tile overlap
tileOverlap.description: Fraction shared between image tiles. More overlap increases inference time.

suppressionIoU.label: Duplicate suppression
suppressionIoU.description: Overlap threshold for suppressing duplicate boxes. Lower values suppress more boxes.

method.label: Placement method
method.description: Triangle intersects the surface. Multiview is experimental; vertex is a legacy advanced method.

minViews.label: Minimum supporting views
minViews.description: Minimum distinct images required for multiview refinement.

maxReprojectionErrorPixels.label: Reprojection tolerance
maxReprojectionErrorPixels.description: Maximum pixel error allowed for multiview matches.
